cohort: A total of 440 parturients who underwent second cesarean section surgery and were registered in a hospital from August 2019 to July 2021 were selected as study subjects.
finding: A nomogram model, based on five identified risk factors (placenta previa, operation time, prenatal anemia, placenta accreta, and uterine inertia), accurately predicts the risk of postpartum hemorrhage after a second cesarean section with good accuracy and differentiation (AUC 0.824 in modeling group, 0.840 in validation group).
mod_finding: The study specifically focuses on women undergoing a second cesarean section, identifying risk factors and establishing a predictive model for postpartum hemorrhage exclusively within this mode of birth.
cross-section timing: Data collected from August 2019 to July 2021
